events.text:
Implemented the repair in [Tautomer.cpp](/workspace/task/source/Code/GraphMol/MolStandardize/Tautomer.cpp:428).

Root cause: the V3000 input contains atropisomeric stereo on a single bond. When tautomerization changed that bond to double, the stereo-preservation path copied the axial single-bond stereo label onto the double bond. RDKit’s SMILES canonicalizer rejected this invalid combination with `bad bond stereo`.

The fix now:

- Preserves E/Z stereo only when both the original and transformed bonds are double bonds.
- Preserves atropisomeric stereo only while the bond remains single.
- Applies normal stereo cleanup whenever tautomerization changes the bond into an incompatible type.
- Removes invalidated bonds from enhanced stereo groups.

Validation completed successfully:

- `python reproduce.py` → `{"status": "workflow_completed"}`
- All five enumerated fixture tautomers serialize.
- Unchanged atropisomeric single bonds retain their stereo.
- Atrop labels do not survive incompatible bond-order changes.
- Unrelated E/Z alkene stereo remains preserved.
- Tetrahedral chirality remains preserved when configured.
- `git diff --check` passes.

Only `source/Code/GraphMol/MolStandardize/Tautomer.cpp` was modified.
